issues.issue: AUTOMATED_FLAG uncited number '3' is a false positive: it is part of 'both phase 3 studies', not an efficacy statistic.
AUTOMATED_FLAG uncited number '10' is a false positive: it is part of the excluded date 10/23/2007, which matches the citation 'received October 23, 2007'.

The equivalence SALT-1 = Study 156-02-235 (and SALT-2 = 156-03-238) is inferred; the citations list the SALT names and the 156-xx study numbers separately without explicitly mapping them to each other.
